assumptions.scoreline_method: Recency-weighted joint final-score frequencies, pooled across home/away orientations and shrunk toward smoothed independent marginals. Minimum-relative-entropy exponential tilting matches the two ridge score means. Postseason scorelines exclude ties. The joint mode predicts a final score.
assumptions.scoreline_log_loss_baseline: The same training-only league score distribution without matchup adjustments; natural logs, probabilities floored at 1e-15.
assumptions.evaluation_method: Expanding-window evaluation: start with the first 60% of dates, then evaluate up to four later blocks. Each block is predicted using only strictly earlier dates. Production refits all completed games.
assumptions.uncertainty_method: Central discrete quantiles from the joint score distribution.
